scientific_integrity: Mathematical claims are presented with an explicit proof and independently recreated finite matrix tests. General degeneracy and trapping mechanisms are prior art; the evaluated heterogeneous-spider divisor, local-survival and zero-site formulas are the proposed contribution.
scientific_limitations: Uniform nonzero adjacency hopping; a single strictly positive absorbing hub; finite heterogeneous spider with at least three arms. The time to absorption is not bounded uniformly in parameters, and weighted bonds, extra traps and onsite disorder are outside scope. Finite verification does not replace the exact proof; independent literature-priority assessment has not occurred.
title: Arithmetic dark spaces and sitewise survival on quantum spider networks
